dataList.name: Field Analysis
dataList.desc:
- Max Stack: 5
- Gain +1 Poise Count when gaining Stacks of this effect
- Turn End: Gain +(Stack) Poise Count
- Turn Start: If this unit is Staggered at Turn Start, recover from Stagger (2 times per Encounter; excluding forced Staggers)
- Base Attack Skills gain the following effects based on Stack:
  · 2+: On Skill Use, deal +(30 / # of Coins)% damage on enemies (rounded down)
  · 3+: Coin Power +1; On Skill Use, convert the final Coin to Unbreakable Coin
  · 4+: On Skill Use, deal +(30 / # of Coins)% damage on enemies (rounded down)
  · 5+: Target's Pierce Resist. +0.1 from Attack Start to Attack End
- The Stack immediately before Skill Use is used to determine whether the damage-boosting and Unbreakable Coin conversion effects are activated

dataList.name: Wedge - Don Quixote
dataList.desc:
- Max Stack: 8
- At sufficient Stacks, empower a certain Skill of Wedge Office Fixer Sinclair
- Turn End: Gain +1 Tremor Count
- Turn Start: If there are no enemy "Wedge Office" characters on the field, this effect expires

dataList.name: Wedge - Sinclair
dataList.desc:
- Max Stack: 8
- At sufficient Stacks, empower a certain Skill of Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote
- Turn End: Gain +1 Tremor Count
- Turn Start: If there are no enemy "Wedge Office" characters on the field, this effect expires

dataList.name: Joint Combo
dataList.desc: If the pertinent Identity is on the field, alive, and isn't immobilized, activate the linked effects (does not activate if the pertinent Identity is in any of the following states: all types of immobilized states, E.G.O Corrosions, and Staggers)
